status: native policy semantics; examples are not tuned or frozen methods

static.periodic: request restart before positive batch indices divisible by restart_period; masked requests are skipped, not queued
static.bernoulli: request when an independent uniform53 draw is strictly less than restart_probability
static.rng_domain: Philox with the colony solve key, current batch, ant UINT32_MAX and step 1; source selection uses step 0

rule.mne: mne_level + min(max_mne_level - mne_level, global_stagnant_batches // stagnation_step); fixed when stagnation_step is zero
rule.restart: request when global_stagnant_batches >= restart_stagnation and completed_epoch_batches >= restart_cooldown; disabled when both thresholds are zero
rule.restart_cooldown: positive completed-batch count; prevents a preserved global stagnation count from forcing restart after every batch
rule.global_stagnation: reset only on strict global-best improvement, preserved across epoch restart

mask_policy: every potentially selected keep action must be enabled in the experiment mask; an unavailable restart falls back to the same region and MNE in keep mode
common_base: all reference regions and twelve-feature construction
archive eligibility, alternative selection and update
construction, checklist LS, sparse pheromone and source RNG
complete FE stopping and independent result verification
